sam: Quick sync - I converted the Next.js + LlamaIndex starter into a reproducible dev container to test cold-start indexing. Seeing a weird rate-limit + retry race: the SDK retries in tight loop and triggers 429s from the hosted API during SSR.

dina: Hmm, SSR doing heavy index queries can be noisy. Which SDK and retry config are you using?

sam: @redwood/js v0.14.0 (node runtime build). Default retry policy. Repro steps: cold start container, hit the indexPage that runs three small retrieval queries during getServerSideProps. First few requests return 200 but then we get several 429s and a backlog. Logs show the SDK doing exponential backoff incorrectly (backoff delay reused across parallel requests).

marco: Can you paste the relevant log snippet?

sam: Sure: ```
[redwood-sdk] request start id=13 route=/v1/query
[redwood-sdk] request start id=14 route=/v1/query
[redwood-sdk] request start id=15 route=/v1/query
[redwood-sdk] response id=13 -> 429 Too Many Requests
[redwood-sdk] retrying id=13 after delay=100ms
[redwood-sdk] retrying id=14 after delay=100ms
[redwood-sdk] backoff timer for id=13 fired -> delay now 100ms (should be 200ms)
[redwood-sdk] response id=14 -> 429
```

dina: That backoff reuse sounds like shared mutable state in the retry scheduler. If multiple calls clone the same policy object and update nextDelay in place, parallel requests will interfere.

marco: Also SSR parallelism often triggers simultaneous retries; we should special-case SSR to limit concurrency or recommend batching. Did you try turning on request coalescing?

sam: I added a small local patch to clone the policy per-request and that removed the cross-talk. But we should fix upstream. I can open a PR with a unit test that spawns 3 parallel mock requests and asserts their backoff counters are independent.

dina: Good plan. For the starter README, add a note: avoid running many parallel retrievals in SSR; prefer server route that aggregates queries or run a warm indexing job. Also give the env knobs for REDWOOD_API_KEY vs NEXT_PUBLIC_.

qa-bot: CI: new PR sam/fix/retry-clone triggered tests (unit=5, integration=2) :running: 

sam: One more gotcha: when using the dev container I had the SDK env var unset inside the container image -> the fallback behavior attempted client anonymous flow and that doubled the requests. Docs should explicitly show how to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in devcontainers.json.

marco: Thanks for the repro + fix. We'll aim for a patch release to v0.14.1 and update the starter template. Also add an integration test in the example that runs the SSR page under a mocked rate-limit to catch regression.

dina: I'll add a short section in the devex handbook about SSR retrieval patterns and a checklist for sample apps (envs, batching, retry sanity).

sam: PR up as draft, linking the devcontainer repro. Thanks team!
